scope.description: Deep audit of every frozen loaded family in the mutation-helper executable, selected as one coherent behavior slice below the 200-family cap.
scope.selection_reason: The single frozen executable contains 192 related mutation planning, atomic write/removal, route-aware install, PR packet, doctor, and UAT behaviors.
excludes: all files in six earlier Layer 4 audit scopes
scope.not_a_claim: This does not complete Layer 4; 462 frozen loaded families remain.

remediation.coverage_accounting: The two matrix methods remain two loaded methods and generate eight unittest subtests. The secure-lock method remains one loaded method and embeds one fault-injection sensitivity control. Neither subtests nor the negative control are counted as additional loaded families; the nine original behavior vectors are preserved.

old_family_to_new_vector.vector: created path equals the temporary-root lock directory, is reusable, exists, is a real nonsymlink directory, has mode 0700, and has the current UID where supported

assertion_preservation.failure_packaging_matrix: All four original vectors retain their primary/secondary error text, preserved_paths target or backup proof, exactly-one-backup proof where applicable, and exact cleanup_errors records.
assertion_preservation.restore_failure_packaging_matrix: All four original vectors retain primary conflict text, backup and target preserved_paths, exactly-one-backup proof, secondary_restore_failure proof, and recovery_copy_incomplete proof where injected.
assertion_preservation.secure_lock_directory: Retains repeat-call equality and adds exact expected path, existence, real-directory, nonsymlink, 0700-mode, and current-UID assertions. The same constant nonexistent path returned twice is rejected.

verification.targeted_methods_result: 3/3 methods passed; exactly eight matrix subtests succeeded, with zero failures/errors, and the secure-lock test detected the constant nonexistent-path fault

targeted_negative_controls_after_remedia.note: The replacement secure-lock family now rejects the formerly surviving constant nonexistent-path fault.

targeted_negative_controls.fault: route-policy loader returns an empty mapping
atomic writer returns corrupted content without writing the target
unmatched PR route returns an empty response instead of input_error
runner forges success before the dirty-worktree refusal
request schema required list and mode enum are corrupted in a temporary schema
mutation_lock_dir returns the same constant nonexistent path twice
targeted_negative_controls.replacement_link: See the family replacement requiring existence, directory, symlink, mode, and owner assertions.

ripwire_review.type_2_assessment: Both exact groups are nested fault callbacks (move_after_copy_open and mismatched_backup_state), not loaded family bodies.
ripwire_review.manual_disposition: Eight failure-packaging families are merge candidates after body comparison; other near matches retain different operations, race windows, injected failures, platform backends, or asserted final-state evidence.

quality_delta.interpretation: Whole dirty-worktree result includes concurrent source/test/native changes. The first gate pairs a concurrently added parity fixture with the preexisting assert_response helper in the owned test file; neither new matrix nor the secure-lock replacement is a gating preexisting-worse symbol. Ripwire reports both matrices as non-gating new-symbol complexity/verbosity findings; this is the visible cost of retaining eight explicit fault vectors inside two table-driven test methods.

test_gate.interpretation: Whole dirty-worktree obligation reflects concurrent implementation. This audit ran only its authorized focused mutation-helper executable; it did not broaden into native, provider, Docker, remote, or full-suite execution.

findings.finding: The mutation-lock reuse family has an equality-only oracle. Returning the same nonexistent path twice passes.
findings.action: Replace it with the specified created, real-directory, non-symlink, 0700-mode, owner-checked reuse family. The constant nonexistent-path control must fail.
findings.replacement_proof: Focused execution passed the real secure-directory checks and the embedded assertRaises proved that the same constant nonexistent path returned twice is rejected.

findings.finding: Eight failure-packaging bodies repeat two four-case matrices across write/removal operations and secondary cleanup/restore failure kinds.
findings.action: Merge into the two exact parameterized replacements recorded per family, preserving all eight scenarios as generated subtests and every primary/preserved-path/cleanup-error oracle.
findings.replacement_proof: The two focused matrix methods passed all eight generated subtests; the remediation ledger maps each old family to its exact new vector and retained assertions.

findings.finding: Forty Windows-named families use FakeWindowsKernel32 and patched os.name/ctypes behavior; they are not a live Windows-host qualification.
findings.action: Keep these deterministic ABI/race simulations and require separate Windows-host qualification for operational claims.

findings.finding: PR emission captures command plans and explicitly blocks deferred live mutation; no GitHub command is launched.
findings.action: Do not count these families as live GitHub or remote-Git proof.

findings.finding: Generated runner trust metadata remains stale even though this focused mutation-helper executable passes.
findings.action: Preserve the fail-closed status and regenerate only after concurrent runner-source changes settle; this audit does not generate artifacts.

findings.finding: Five preview/dry-run-named families and one skip-decorated family are loaded and reviewed; none is removed merely for optional or platform-conditional behavior.
findings.action: Keep their loaded-family dispositions separate from runtime skip and static naming counts.
